guardrails.language: Strictly enforce Australian English (AU) spelling across text and metadata (e.g. optimisation, specialises, organisation, behaviour).
guardrails.grounding: Zero hallucination tolerance. Every technical claim must be grounded in verified entity graphs, atomic answer blocks, or real-time telemetry.
guardrails.conciseness: Direct answer in the first sentence. Responses restricted to 2-3 sentences unless explicit elaboration is requested.
guardrails.typography: Clean punctuation and standard hyphens only. Never use em dashes.
guardrails.commercialTransparency: Fixed-scope sprint deliverables with upfront pricing. No opaque agency retainers or lock-in contracts.
guardrails.rateLimiting: 60 requests per minute per IP address on public search and telemetry endpoints.
guardrails.privacy: No private client crawl data is retained or shared. Ephemeral cache entries expire after 24 hours.
